content.text:
`POST /api/messages` now notifies the recipient after the message is stored. I added `src/lib/notify.ts` with `notifyNewMessage`, and the handler in `src/app/api/messages/route.ts` calls it just before the 201 response.

The email goes to the recipient's account address and says a new secure message is waiting and to sign in, with `APP_BASE_URL`. Each registered device gets a push with the same generic title and text. Neither carries the subject, body, patient name or reason for care.

Each send is wrapped in its own try/catch, so a failure never affects the 201. Failures are logged as a warning with only the message id, recipient id and channel. Typecheck and the 18 existing tests pass. I didn't add a test for the notification itself.
